explication: ARVIO is a cross-device media hub: users connect their own catalogs, servers, live-TV playlists, add-ons, and tracking accounts, then browse and play available sources while maintaining profile-scoped library state. The graph covers the documented discovery, live TV/sports, add-on/Telegram, playback, calendar, and cloud/tracker capabilities. Several subsystems are represented by their exact source files or enclosing directories because their implementation was not sampled; those links rely on README statements rather than inspected call sites.
